<img style="display: block; margin-right: auto; margin-left: 0;" alt="" height="180" src="data:image/png;base64," width="173" /></p><p>&nbsp;&nbsp;</p><p>&nbsp;</p><p><span style="color: #333333; font-size: 2em;"><b>21st Stratagem</b></span></p>

<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<span style="color: #333333; font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular; font-size: x-large;"><span lang="zh-CN"><b>金蝉脱壳</b></span></span></p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">(jīn chán tuō qiào)</span></p>

</p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<span style="color: #333333; font-size: x-large;"><i>The Golden Cicada Sloughs off Its Shell</i></span></p>

<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
Mask yourself either by leaving flamboyant traits behind, going
incognito, or creating an illusion to fit your objective.</span></p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>

</p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
In the early 190s A.D., after parting ways with the warlord Yuan Shu
(<span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">袁术</span></span>,
died 199 A.D.), the warlord Lü Bu (<span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">呂布</span></span>,
died 199 A.D.) headed to northern China. There he aided Yuan Shu's
relative Yuan Shao (cf. Stratagem 19) in putting down an uprising.
Shortly after, Yuan Shao grew suspicious that Lü Bu would betray
him, and so sent soldiers to 'act as his guard' while secretly
plotting kill him in 
</span></p>
<p class="western" style="break-before: page; line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; page-break-before: always; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
his sleep. Realizing this, Lü Bu had his friend stay in his tent as
a decoy, who was then killed by the assassins in Lü Bu's stead,
allowing for Lü Bu to escape [6].</span></p>

<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<span style="color: #333333; font-family: Liberation Serif, serif; font-size: large;"><i><span style="font-weight: normal;">The
Golden Cicada Sloughs off Its Shell</span></i></span><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
is associated with the eighteenth hexagram, <i>Mountain
over Wind</i>.
Movement, symbolized by the lower trigram of Wind follows the
rigidity symbolized by the upper trigram of Mountain, resulting in
stagnation. The yielding yin lines in both trigrams are bound above
by solid yang lines, symbolizing an inability to move forward and the
need for a readjustment, or, a new beginning, like a cicada shedding
its skin.</span></p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"> 
</p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-family: Liberation Serif, serif; font-size: large;"><i><span style="font-weight: normal;">The
Golden Cicada Sloughs off Its Shell</span></i></span><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">,
in the Ba Gua Zhang, is also the name of one of the sixty-four hands,
in particular, the third form in the Palace of Wind. It corresponds
with the 48th hexagram, <i>Water
outside of Wind</i>.
This form relies on a blending with the forces of the opponent, and
conforming to its bodily movements, just as both Wind and Water
conform and adapt to the terrain, or, to the situation<span style="text-decoration: none;">
</span><span style="text-decoration: none;">[1],
[28]</span>.</span></p><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">&nbsp;</span></p><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">&nbsp;</span>

<div dir="ltr" id="Section73" style="column-count: 2;"><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">1) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">我把我的饭忘在微波炉里了。</span></span></span></p>

	2) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">你有没有完成那个表格？你填写了多少？</span></span></span></p>

	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: medium;">Trans.: Did you finish that

	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	3) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">你不应该在这里游泳，有鲨鱼。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	4)<span style="font-family: times;"> </span></span><span style="color: #ffa400; font-size: large;"><span style="color: #0047AB !important;">有一只金蝉在我们头上飞。</span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	5) Q: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">你还有多长时间才离开？</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="text-decoration: none;">&nbsp;&nbsp; </span></span><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="text-decoration: none;">A:
	<span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN"><span lang="zh-CN">我不知道，我还没买飞机票。</span></span></span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	6) Q: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">你应该早就把垃圾拿出来，为什么还</span></span>
    </span>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;没有呢？</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="text-decoration: none;">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </span></span><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="text-decoration: none;">A:
	<span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN"><span lang="zh-CN">那个垃圾桶很难拿，因为没有把</span></span>
    </span>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;手。</span></span></span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br>
	7) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">长颈鹿的脖子为什么很长？</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	8) Q: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">实习生检查什么时候结束的？</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="text-decoration: none;">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </span></span><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="text-decoration: none;">A:
	<span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN"><span lang="zh-CN">不久前。</span></span></span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="text-decoration: none;">9)</span></span><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="font-family: times;"> </span></span><span style="color: #ffa400; font-size: large;"><span style="color: #0047AB !important;">谁在鸡蛋壳上写字了？</span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	10)  <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">我们快要点餐了，要不要一起分享？</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	11)  <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">我很尊敬那个学者。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	12)  <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">尊严比利益重要。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	13) Q: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">你工作了吗？</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; <span face="Noto Sans CJK SC Black, sans-serif" style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="font-family: Liberation Serif, Times New Roman, serif;"><span lang="en-US">A:
	</span></span></span><span style="color: #333333; font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular; font-size: large;"><span lang="zh-CN">我刚刚参加实习。</span></span></p>
</div>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><br />

</p><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><a href="https://apecrank.blogspot.com/2011/03/notes-from-china-chapter-20-disturb.html">Previous Chapter</a>

</p>
